question.text: Which of the following is NOT among the distributor covenants prescribed in the AIF Distribution Agreement per Chapter 9.7.3?

answer.text: Distributor shall not alter, add to, modify or erase any marketing literature or document provided by the Investment Manager.
Distributor shall not incur or purport to incur any debt or liability on behalf of the Investment Manager unless specifically authorised in writing.
Distributor shall not allow or offer any rebate, directly or indirectly, as an inducement for purchase, redemption or transaction of Units.
Distributor shall independently decide the applicable management fee for each investor, subject to a 2% ceiling.

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 9.7.3 lists distributor covenants: no alteration of materials, no unauthorised debt/liability, attendance at seminars/training, and NO REBATES as inducement. Fee-setting is the Manager's prerogative, not the distributor's — Option D inverts the role. The Trap: Options A, B, C are verbatim covenants. Option D is tempting because distributors do negotiate some commercials, but fee-setting for investors is NOT delegated. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-B Cat III Distributor tests the same covenants from the distributor's compliance-checklist view. XXI-A PMS distributor has an analogous code. Manager's Pro-Tip: Operationalise the no-rebate rule by requiring distributors to self-certify on onboarding that no side payments / cash-backs have been promised to the investor — reduces SEBI-inspection findings materially.
